why: A gives the client a true reading setup: the swing-arm lamp puts focused light on the page, and the dark round side table matches the bookcase and floor, while the cognac leather chair adds warmth. B's rice-paper lamp only gives ambient light, and its walnut-and-gold nesting tables break the dark-wood scheme. In both proposals, a single 90 cm bookcase falls short of filling a good part of the left wall.
